headline: Colombian Congress Considers Proposal to Reduce Corporate Tax Rates to 31%
summary: The Colombian Congress is evaluating the Economic Rescue Law, which proposes lowering the corporate tax rate from 35% to 33% in 2027 and further to 31% starting in 2028.
why: Corporate income tax rates affect corporate net profitability and foreign direct investment competitiveness in Colombia.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Proposed reductions in corporate income tax rates would lower effective tax burdens for businesses.
